name: Spring
noun: a bouncy coil SPRING on a stand
axis: Axis: coil turns and twin springs (2, 3, 4 coils, then side springs), then a second tier, a crystal ball, a crown cage.
ranks: A short fat fresh-green coil spring (two thick coils) standing on a cream plate with a small grey steel cap on top.
Rank 2 taller again: four thick coils, thin brass rings on the cap, brass feet on the plate.
Rank 3 plus a second, shorter green spring standing on the right side of it (twin springs).
Rank 4 plus a third, shorter green spring on the left side (symmetrical) and a small gold arrow pointing up on the main cap.
Rank 5 plus a second, smaller green spring stacked on top of the tall one, with a larger gold upward arrow on its cap.
Rank 6 where the top cap is a blue-white crystal ball clearly WIDER than the spring, with a gold ring.
Rank 7 plus a gold crown-shaped cage around the crystal ball, two gold fins at the sides and a small ornate gold and white plate. The most impressive machine on the sheet, still clean.
